title: The Hellhound
text: A three-headed hound guards the bridge, each head as big as a barrel, its breath steaming in the hot air. One head growls for meat. One whines for a song. One just watches you, very still, and that is the one to worry about.

options.label: Feed all three heads, and pray it is enough for the one that watches.

outcomes.text: All three mouths eat at once, and it lets you pass, full. The watching head never stops watching.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings it to sleep, softly, head by head.

outcomes.text: All three heads fall asleep, snoring smoke.
Two heads sleep. The third, the watching one, does not; it has been waiting for this.

options.label: Fight it. Three heads only means three throats to cut.

outcomes.text: Each head bites in turn, and the watching one is the worst.
